frozen_before: any C4 rollout, analysis or candidate selection exists

why_c4_exists.what_c3_proved: Actionable commitment forks are common and replicate: C3_PASS at LCB95 0.7466 against a 0.20 bar, STAGE4_PASS on 3/3 policies both legs. A different legal response frequently improves the situation.
why_c4_exists.what_c3_never_measured: whether the improving response COSTS anything elsewhere
why_c4_exists.what_o3_showed: O3 reproduced G0 rather than specializing. Its trigger fired in 99.98% of episodes, so it trained on effectively G0's own distribution -- but the deeper gap is that actionability alone gives PPO no reason to trade anything away. Without an opportunity cost, an improvement folds into the generalist.
why_c4_exists.the_stronger_question: C3 asked 'is there another legal response that improves this situation?'. C4 asks 'does the response that helps here make you worse somewhere else?'
why_c4_exists.explicitly_not_the_plan: narrowing the O3 trigger until PPO produces something different. A narrower trigger is only justified once a tradeoff is demonstrated, and must then be derived from that tradeoff rather than invented.

target_pattern.shape: a preference REVERSAL between two legal team responses across two naturally occurring context classes
target_pattern.table: in context A, response R1 beats R2; in context B, response R2 beats R1
target_pattern.why_this_is_the_raw_material: A reversal means no single response dominates, which is the minimal condition under which keeping two policies can pay. Actionability without reversal is an upgrade, not a strategy.

unit_of_analysis.state: natural decision states reached by frozen G0 play
unit_of_analysis.no_counterfactual_labels_used_for_select: C3/Stage-4 fork labels and best_team_response are NOT inputs to C4 selection

context_classes.rule: frozen, natural, label-free binary partitions read from run_g0_v2_evaluation.legal_context
partitions: score_stratum: leading vs trailing (tied excluded from pair tests)
context_classes.pairing: a context pair is the two sides of ONE partition; cross-partition pairs are not tested
context_classes.why_binary_and_frozen: an open search over context definitions would rediscover the multiplicity problem C1 was rejected for

utility.name: carrier_survival
utility.status: SCREEN PROXY, exactly as in C3
utility.explicit_limitation: a reversal on this proxy is a screening result, not a task-outcome claim. Any O4 that follows must still be judged on final score differential, per de6fb58.

per_response_pair_and_partition: mean_utility(R1) - mean_utility(R2) >= 0.10 in class A, with episode-clustered 95% CI excluding zero
mean_utility(R2) - mean_utility(R1) >= 0.10 in class B, with episode-clustered 95% CI excluding zero
reversal_criterion.delta_source: inherited from the C3 contract's delta, not newly chosen
reversal_criterion.why_both: a single-direction effect is actionability, which C3 already established

replication.requirement: the same response pair and partition must reverse in the same direction in >= 2 of 3 policies

seeds.rule: discovery selects at most one candidate; confirmation tests only that candidate on the confirmation block

sampling.design: stratified over policy x opponent, mirroring the Stage-3 amendment
sampling.seed_derivation: int(sha256(this file's bytes)[:8], 16), resolved and recorded when the sample manifest is built
sampling.response_enumeration: EXHAUSTIVE within every sampled state; sampling responses would let a hoped-for tradeoff select itself

C4_PASS.condition: at least one (response pair, partition) reverses per the criterion in >= 2/3 policies on discovery AND replicates on the confirmation block
C4_PASS.authorizes: freezing a narrower, label-free O4 precursor DERIVED FROM the demonstrated tradeoff
C4_PASS.does_not_authorize: O4 training until that precursor is frozen and its recall/precision audited on a fresh block

C4_NO_REVERSAL.meaning: the task offers actionable corrections without opportunity cost under these context classes and this utility
C4_NO_REVERSAL.action: STOP. Do not narrow the O3 trigger, do not train O4, and do not widen the context-class list to keep searching. Escalate to changing strategic demand -- opponents or scenario pressure -- under a new preregistration.

o4_precursor_requirement.must_be: natural, label-free, causally available at decision time
o4_precursor_requirement.must_be_derived_from: the demonstrated tradeoff, not invented to be narrow
o4_precursor_requirement.prohibited: adding an arbitrary geometric threshold because O3's trigger was too broad
o4_precursor_requirement.firing_rate_requirement: must NOT fire in essentially every episode; O3 fired in 99.98% and consequently trained on G0's own distribution. Enough separation is required that O4 experiences a genuinely different optimization distribution.
o4_precursor_requirement.audit: recall and precision measured on a fresh block before training, run once, evaluation-only, per the ce7949f pattern

prohibited: using C3/Stage-4 fork labels or best_team_response to select C4 candidates
reusing the O3 demand-gate block 9830000+ for anything
widening the frozen context-class list after seeing results
adjusting delta, support minima or the replication requirement after any C4 number exists
training O4 on a C4_NO_REVERSAL result
claiming a task-outcome tradeoff from a carrier_survival screen
immutability: After any C4 rollout produces data, none of the above may change: context classes, utility, delta, support minima, replication requirement, seed blocks, sampling design, or the outcome conditions.
